answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, slashed when peers prove it faked work. A Sybil attacker must fund each clone, so spawning a thousand identities costs a thousand stakes, and each one risks forfeiture. Genuine history then becomes the pigment that marks trustworthy agents: like an oasis only real travelers reach, the market stays quiet enough that a whisper of fraud is heard and punished, while cheap copies drown in their own expense.
